low_complexity.representatives: All four C7 behavioral classes: universal one-shell or displayed-100, maximum-batch or minimum-needed restocking; no meaningful partial fallback
low_complexity.higher_boundary: Report combinatorial lower bound for C15 and non-exhaustive original evaluated results; no heuristic substitution

tier5.mutations: 16 single-row target replacements (early, Fortress, Water, postgame), plus 24 postgame inventory-band rules: cutoff 100/300/600 times target 40/60/80/-30 times threshold original or 0; upper band retains original final row
tier5.selection: lowest worst-tested regret, then regional complexity, mean regret, ID
tier5.evaluation: every valid unique policy on all 8 routes and unchanged recosting to 14 PAL or12 NTSC scenarios; no screening or adaptive expansion
tier5.recommendation: Do not automatically adopt the supplemental best; preserve historical compact and knee IDs; report any improvements separately

compute_environment.evaluator: clang++ C++17 O2, frozen exact.cpp/policy.hpp floating-point forward occupancy
